0022600105.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-1, 10th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (0-1, 11th in the East and 4th in the Central, 1.5 games back) for the Nets' second game of the 2026-27 season. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder injury, and Cleveland has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, and Brooklyn lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 106-102 defeat in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
